ratings.label: none
ratings.reason: Purely procedural description of the brief's structure with no motivational, relational, or directive leadership content.

ratings.label: affiliative
ratings.reason: Centers on warmth, gratitude, praise, and reassurance that there is no pressure, building emotional bonds rather than directing the work.

ratings.label: coercive
ratings.reason: Demands strict compliance, rejects the employee's opinions, and threatens replacement and personal blame for any deviation.

ratings.label: authoritative
ratings.reason: Articulates a clear vision of accurate, explainable valuations and why it matters, then leaves the means and route to the employee.

ratings.label: coaching
ratings.reason: Frames the task as a growth opportunity, prompts self-reflection on strengths and blind spots, and explicitly tolerates failure for the sake of learning.

ratings.label: pacesetting
ratings.reason: The manager models high standards, demands speed, refuses to give guidance, and threatens to take over work that falls short.

ratings.label: democratic
ratings.reason: Solicits the employee's ideas, admits uncertainty, and treats their proposals as a vote that shapes team direction.
